bodyHtml:
🎓 Onsite & Remote Training · Logan & Surrounds

Computer Training Logan. Learn At Your Pace, With A Trainer Who Gets It.

Whether you're a complete beginner, a small business owner, or a senior wanting to stay connected, Computer Repairs Logan offers personalised, easy-to-follow onsite and remote computer training tailored to your needs. No tech jargon, no rushing, just clear, helpful guidance at your pace.

Book A Training Session
✓ Onsite Or Remote
✓ One-On-One Sessions
✓ Flexible Scheduling
✓ Ongoing Support
Onsite Training

At Your Home Or Office.

We'll come to you, whether it's your living room or your workspace. Perfect for those who learn best with hands-on, face-to-face support, no need to pack up your computer or drive anywhere. Ideal for seniors, beginners, or home offices.

Remote Training

Via Zoom Or Teams.

Prefer to learn from the comfort of your desk? Our remote sessions are fully interactive and just as effective, share your screen for real-time help, great for busy schedules or clients further afield.

Software & Skills

What We Can Help You With.

We train people on a wide range of software and digital platforms, Windows or macOS, Android or iOS.

💻

Operating Systems

Windows 10/11, macOS, navigating your desktop, keyboard and mouse basics.

📊

Productivity Suites

Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), Google Docs, Sheets and Slides.

☁️

Cloud Storage

Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive, backing up files and photos to the cloud.

🛡️

Online Safety

Recognising scams and phishing emails, plus general security tools like Norton and Malwarebytes.

Training For Seniors

Independence & Confidence With Technology.

We love helping older Logan residents become more independent and confident with technology.

  • Send and receive emails. Stay in touch without the confusion.
  • Make video calls to family. Zoom, Skype and FaceTime made simple.
  • Browse the internet safely. Avoid scams and dodgy links.
  • Use social media to connect. With loved ones near and far.
  • Read online newspapers and watch shows. Streaming made easy.
Business-Focused Training

Give Your Team The Tools They Need.

We offer structured training in the Microsoft Office Suite, file management and backups, cloud collaboration tools and cybersecurity awareness, helping office staff streamline communication and increase productivity.

Why Choose Us

More Than Just Tech Experts.

Experienced, skilled communicators who make complex topics easy to understand, flexible daytime, evening and weekend appointments, fair pricing with no surprise fees, and ongoing support after your session.

Related Services

Keep Building Your Digital Confidence.

Curious about AI tools alongside the basics? Our Learn About AI workshops build on the same foundations. Want to lock down your accounts once you're confident? We can set up a password manager and 2FA for you.

Training a family member on safe screen time habits? See our family safety & screen time service, or ask about assistive tech setup for low-vision or accessibility needs.

Not Sure Where To Start?

Let's chat about your goals and create a training plan that works for you.

Book A Training Session

Frequently Asked Questions

Computer Training Questions, Answered.

What is the best way to start learning computer basics at home?

The best way is through structured training sessions, like ours, which guide you through essential tasks like managing files, browsing the internet, and using common apps in a clear, step-by-step format.

Do you offer beginner computer courses for adults?

Yes. We provide beginner computer training for adults with no prior tech experience, delivered in a stress-free, encouraging way.

Is your training suitable for remote workers or freelancers?

Yes, our training is ideal for remote professionals needing to improve digital tools like Zoom, Google Workspace, Trello, or time management software.

How long does each session last?

Sessions are typically one hour but can be extended based on your needs. You can book one-off help or a series of lessons for progressive learning.

Can businesses book recurring group training?

Yes, we offer corporate training packages and recurring sessions for small businesses to onboard new staff or upskill teams in programs like Xero, Microsoft Teams, or Dropbox.

What makes your training different from free online tutorials?

Our training is personalised, live and interactive. Unlike passive YouTube videos or generic guides, we answer your questions in real time and adapt to how you learn best.

Ready To Feel Confident With Your Tech?

Book a session with Computer Repairs Logan, onsite or remote, at your own pace.

Book A Training Session
